analysis:
Examined configuration.md:312–597, its complete changed-range map, and the mlx-swift-lm submodule metadata/pointer patch. The new documentation at docs/reference/configuration.md:313 describes default-on fused causal SDPA for eligible full-attention prefill chunks, excluding live packed paged KV, with a process-latched rollback not forwarded to LaunchAgents. The remaining supplied configuration describes unchanged model admission, memory/media budgets, hashing, cache encryption/scope/TTL, environment scrubbing and qualification limits; these surrounding statements do not establish new controls or regressions. No concrete vulnerability is independently supported by this documentation or the commit pointer alone.
The dependency advances at libs/mlx-swift-lm:1, but its implementation diff is absent. Integration must examine that diff, especially Libraries/MLXLMCommon/ContinuousBatchingV2/AttentionV1.swift (named at configuration.md:313): causal visibility with cached prefixes, chunk offsets and both KV backends; packed-paged exclusion and geometry eligibility; bounded transient allocation under existing memory grants; cancellation responsiveness (T-010); output equivalence (T-007/TB-007); and cache-state/scope preservation (A-001, T-028, T-041). Check any other dependency changes against encryption fail-closed behavior (T-008), authorization bindings (T-053) and native media handling (T-050) where affected. T-041's retained SSD-only statements differ from surrounding resident-cache documentation, but those lines are unchanged and do not establish drift introduced by this PR. Missing dependency source remains a material coverage limit, not proof of safety or a missing control.
